purpose: Common, auditable HBM2 baseline for HBMSim, Ramulator 2.1, and DRAMSys validation.

hbmsim.known_difference: The profile fixes the SID/stack selector to zero because the Ramulator HBM2_2Gb preset has one SID; HBMSim therefore needs no SID hierarchy for this baseline.

ramulator2.address_mapper: PassThroughAddrMapper with hierarchical trace vectors from address_mapping
ramulator2.known_difference: The V0.3 timed-trace adapter is applied during reference CI to preserve absolute arrivals and emit callback-derived completion records.

dramsys.known_difference: The V0.3 input preparer derives profile-specific memspec and dense mapping JSON from the pinned stock schema. Its STL input elides the fixed-zero SID/stack bit, preserving every dynamic address field; DRAMSys retains its own command/timing implementation.

comparison_status: V0.3 alignment in progress: every request is one 32 B HBM2 payload with an absolute 1 ns arrival tick and SID/stack selector zero; DRAMSys receives profile-derived HBM2 organization, timing, and dense address-mapping JSON.
